title: done accepts an anchor run's prune of _anchors.csv rows whose source no fact of the article cites, without the goal naming that source
goal: done's dropped-ledger-row reason in _tools/bl_land.py does not count a dropped _anchors.csv row whose (path, source) no fact of that article cites at the item's base, so an anchor run's prune of orphan rows lands without its goal naming the source (SP-tjap3mdd: BG-5fkown4o's re-anchor of langgraph.md dropped two unlocated rows of S-6buofrld, done refused it as outside-touches and land removed the worktree); a dropped row of a source a fact still cites is refused as today

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 13 of 15, "Landing and close: clause credit by carrier, ledger checks by item, the code-lane wait and checks that run behaviour"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates.
